def _ve_side(A, ia, B, jb, tol, cone_tol):
    from math import asin
    from .geom import angle_floor, coord_scale, turn_angle, turn_floor
    nB=outward_normal(B,jb)
    ap,a,an=(A[k%len(A)] for k in (ia-1,ia,ia+1))
    b0,b1=edge(B,jb)
    ell=min(norm(sub(a,ap)),norm(sub(an,a)),norm(sub(b1,b0)))
    fl=angle_floor(coord_scale((ap,a,an,b0,b1)),ell)
    ct=max(cone_tol,fl) if cone_tol is not None else max(tol/ell,fl)
    ta=turn_angle(A,ia)
    if ta<0 and ta < -max(asin(min(max(ct,0.),1.)),turn_floor(A,ia)):
        return -1
    lo,hi=outward_normal(A,ia-1),outward_normal(A,ia)
    v=neg(nB); c1,c2=cross(lo,v),cross(v,hi)
    if c1>ct and c2>ct: return 1
    return 0 if c1>=-ct and c2>=-ct and dot(v,add(lo,hi))>0 else -1
